description: Reads one PA1000 or PA2000 polarization-analyzer channel's cached DeviceOS optical configuration and publishes its validated canonical three-waveplate axis matrix. MPC320 is intentionally unsupported until its driver exposes the same optical-configuration task.
summary: Read a PA1000 or PA2000 analyzer optical configuration and waveplate axes.

deviceId.description: PA1000 or PA2000 DeviceOS identifier that owns the requested analyzer channel.

channel.description: One-based polarization-analyzer channel whose optical configuration is read.

device.configuration.observation.polariz.description: Observed DeviceOS optical-configuration snapshot for the selected analyzer channel.

device.configuration.calibration.polariz.description: Validated canonical 3x3 waveplate-axis matrix derived from the selected channel's calibrated optical configuration.
